Modern & Beautifully Maintained 4 Bed / 4 Bath Home
Clay Farm, Leopardstown

A stunning 4-bedroom property presented in turn-key condition, available for its first letting. Located in the highly sought-after Clay Farm development, this home offers modern living in a prime location.

Key Features:
- 3 spacious double bedrooms & 1 large single bedroom
- Additional attic room offering flexible use (home office / playroom)
- 4 stylish bathrooms
- Underfloor heating ground floor
- Electric car charging facility to charge Plug-in cars.
- Bright, modern interiors finished to an excellent standard
- Beautifully landscaped rear garden (low maintenance)
- Designated parking with visitor spaces available
- Only a 10-minute walk to the Luas
- Surrounded by excellent primary & secondary schools
- Minutes from Leopardstown Shopping Centre & Carrickmines Park
